# copper_hammered_cup — realism QA

Evidence: f1048, f1057, f1060. Fixed calibrated cameras and common instance pose. Mean visible IoU 0.833; worst 0.764; RGB histogram intersection 0.619. Review: `../review/copper_hammered_cup_compare.jpg`.

Grades: silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B.

- Replaced fine shader orange-peel texture with coarse geometric hammered hollows and smooth lower band.
- Added two calibrated evidence views and refit placement and diameter.
- Replaced coarse cavity with thin profile-following copper walls.
- Refined documented per-view exposure in Cycles to match capture auto-exposure; no raster recoloring or reflection baking.
- Round 2: replaced drilled-looking regular dimples with overlapping irregular shallow hammer impressions, narrowed the rolled rim and corrected copper reflectance/roughness.
- Round 2: revised estimated mass from copper density and modeled thin-shell area.
- Round 2: refined a single common pose and size against all three fixed-camera silhouettes, with extra weight on the weakest view.
- Added three calibrated evidence views, source-only manual masks, numeric IoU and masked RGB histogram comparisons.
- Added physics mass/density/friction/restitution/COM/fragility metadata with uncertainty and synchronized native rigid bodies.

Remaining:
- The cabinet door occludes the right side in the close views. Individual dent locations, hidden circumference and true alloy/plating remain unresolved; geometry uses axial completion.
- Product identity and actual weighed mass are unverified; physics parameters are explicitly estimated.
- External scene integration: the separate cabinetry support differs from this photo-fitted base by +82.5 mm. Its assumed shelf elevation needs reconciliation; cookware was not moved off its source fit. See review/support_reconciliation.json.

Mass is an engineering prior, not the real product weight. `physics` includes the shell-area check, density, 40% mass uncertainty, per-body COM and contact coefficients. No deformable item is present in this set.

Per-view bounding dimensions and three projected width samples are measured in source pixels. Rim wall thickness, hidden hinge internals and unreadable markings cannot be resolved to physical accuracy from these images; nominal values are not photo measurements.

Previous notes are archived in `../review/before/copper_hammered_cup/notes.md`; current geometry, poses and physical properties are authoritative in `model.json`. GLB contains visuals; load the JSON joints/collision mapping for simulation.
